written_all_degree_proof: Coprime homogeneous initial forms give nonzero monomial Jacobian, localdegree rs, restricted ordersr/s and q|gcd. Projective pencil [U^(s/g):V^(r/g)] has degree rs/g and localdegreee=r+s-1 at critical direction, giving e<=rs/g. q>1 forces coprime normalizedordersa,b>=2, hence e>=5q-1 and degree>=6q². Actualq=nf gives scalar markedquotient1/n(1,1), nf|e+1, ell>=6nf² and d>=ell+1.
